source_title: Mamdani warns DoorDash’s $17B Instacart bid risks price hikes after $131M settlement
source_excerpt: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani is not happy with delivery platform DoorDash's spending $17 billion to buy rival Instacart. And he made it clear in a post online. Mamdani's dismay comes almost a month after he managed to win $131.5 million from DoorDash for delivery workers in New York. In September, Mayor Mamdani announced a historic $131.5 million enforcement action against DoorDash for systematic violations of New York City's Delivery Worker Laws.
